commands.command: QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev .env DSN> cargo test -p quansio-server --test enterprise_identity -- --nocapture # in-test OIDC provider over loopback HTTP, identity paths as quansio_app; the real-IdP case prints BLOCKED_EXTERNAL without QUANSIO_TEST_OIDC_*
cargo test -p quansio-server --lib enterprise # id_token checks, mapping resolution, SCIM parsing, key shape, custody handles

QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev .env DSN> cargo test -p quansio-server --test identity --test api --test schema_bootstrap # sign-in (incl. a returning user as quansio_app), API ownership scan, migrations
ops001_mutations.sh # 21 compiling mutants across the verifier, mapping, linking, enforcement, SCIM, principals, RBAC and authentication
QUANSIO_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=<dev .env DSN> bash scripts/ci/ci.sh # binaries pinned via QUANSIO_TEST_SERVER_BIN/SEED_BIN
